data.description: When a reefclaw is killed, its body spasms horrifically.  Immediately upon dying, the reefclaw makes a full attack against a creature it threatens.  If more than one creature is within reach, roll randomly for each attack to determine the target (which may be another reefclaw).
data.name: Death Frenzy
